author: turboderp
problem: Converted output already has quantization settings in config.json, but no generated per-module inventory of stored tensors, shapes, byte counts and quantization format.
reasoning:
Adds quant_config.py and calls its writer after conversion output is compiled. It constructs a config and model without loading weights, walks leaf modules and asks the safetensors collection for matching header metadata. Matching uses either an exact key or prefix followed by a dot, avoiding accidental prefix collisions. Linear extracts its EXL3 storage probe into a reusable method and exposes quant_format_id. For EXL3 leaves, the last packed dimension divided by 16 recovers K because the existing 256-element tile occupies 256*K/16 int16 words.

The sidecar copies the existing quantization_config object and adds tensor_storage; util/add_quant_config.py can backfill it. The new update_config helper literally checks `tied_word_embeddings` and sets it to True when present. This spelling and polarity are recorded as written, not normalized to another config convention; the rationale and compatibility of that adjustment are not established by this diff.
impact: Creates a machine-readable storage description useful to downstream consumers without loading full weight tensors. This is an output-format/interface expansion worth a second structural snapshot. Existing converted directories can be annotated with the utility, subject to successful config/model construction.
